items.title: MushGuard
items.description: A mushroom identification and mapping system made exclusively for Biliranons. Scan a mushroom to find out what species it is, whether it's edible, and how long it stays safe to eat.

items.title: BiPSU SRMS
items.description: A scholarship portal built exclusively for Biliran Province State University's SDISS office. It archives scholarship records and recommends eligible students for the university's exclusive scholarships.

items.title: Ticketnode
items.description: An event ticketing system designed for disseminating tickets and creating events exclusively for biliran province. Viewers can now search for events and buy their tickets online, then organizers can create their events and open the sales to the public.
